verdict.rationale: Supermemory is an API-first memory product. Its docs include an API reference with official TypeScript and Python clients that wrap the API, plus documented add, search, memory, and document list/get/update/delete operations with code examples. An llms.txt index is live for agents, and an agent skill is provided so agents use the real endpoints and auth. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and no independent or hands-on confirmation of driving the API.
